items.title: Perplexity Intelligence: New AI Research Platform Launches
items.what_en: Perplexity has launched Intelligence, a next-generation AI research platform that combines real-time web search with advanced reasoning capabilities. It aims to provide verified, citation-backed insights for complex decision-making tasks to researchers, analysts, and enterprises.
items.how_to_try: Immediate availability for enterprise customers; individual researchers and small teams can access a limited preview version via waitlist.

items.title: Microsoft Expands AI Role in Scientific Research Labs
items.what_en: Microsoft has launched a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities designed for scientific research laboratories, integrating AI-powered data analysis, experiment design, and research collaboration tools into laboratory management systems. This initiative aims to accelerate discovery timelines across multiple disciplines.
items.how_to_try: Available to academic institutions, government research facilities, and corporate R&D departments through Microsoft Azure.

items.title: OpenAI Launches Perplexity Framework for AI Evaluation
items.what_en: OpenAI has introduced a comprehensive framework centered on perplexity as the primary metric for evaluating AI model progress. This framework provides developers with a standardized approach to measuring emerging capabilities across language models, aiming for consistent evaluation standards in the AI community.
items.how_to_try: Immediately available to researchers and commercial developers through OpenAI's developer portal.

items.title: Cognition Launches Devin Bots for Multi-Day Coding Projects
items.what_en: Cognition launched Devin Bots, which are coding agents designed to manage teams of Devins (Cognition's AI software engineering agent) on multi-day projects.

items.title: ChatGPT Adds Faster Live Dictation and Accounting Plugin
items.what_en: ChatGPT has introduced faster Live Dictation, allowing real-time speech transcription with text visibility and no 10-minute recording limit. Additionally, an Accounting plugin is now available to support tasks like transaction reconciliation, invoice entries, and month-end reports.
items.how_to_try: Live Dictation is rolling out across various plans and platforms, and the Accounting plugin is available.
